title: Ek sakta hai biyabaan ki fiza qamosh hai
body:
Ek sakta hai biyabaan ki fiza qamosh hai
qaak par laashe pade hai karbala qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
subha ki ahle haram ko yaad aati hai azaa'n
waqte maghrib hai, shabeehe mustafa qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Wo humakna muskaaara aur lipatna shaah se
Asghare masoom ki har ek ada qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai sakina god me zainab ke aansu hai rawaa'n
soti hai masoom aur maa behawa qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
hai shaheedo'n ke bhi laashe , laashaye sheh ke qareeb
qaafila saalar chup hai, qaafela qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kuch dhua'n baaqi abhi hai, dher hai kuch raakh ke
sheh ke qaime jal chuke saari faza qamosh hai
<<DIVIDER>>
bediya'n hai paae abid me to gardan me hai touq
roti hai zanjeer lekin naqshe paa qamosh hai
